cues.description: Generic notification. Single bright A5; neutral, glanceable.
You were named directly. Rising fifth D5>A5 - more insistent than ping.
Incoming message, ambient. Gentle E5>F#5 step up.
Message sent. Quick falling step - outgoing, no attention needed.
The agent needs your input. Three rising notes ending unresolved on B5.
Task complete. A5 resolving down to home D5 - closure.
Long-running job finished. D-A-D octave flourish with a warm low floor.
Something failed. Low damped D4 with a minor-second rub. Dark, never loud.
Caution, non-fatal. Single muted F4 with slow vibrato.
Task/agent kicked off. Upward glide into D5 with an octave lift.
Milestone tick. Tiny wooden D6 blip - felt more than heard.
Session/agent connected. Octave up, D5>D6.
Session ended. The same octave, coming down.
Permission granted / confirmed. Quick bright F#5>A5.
Permission declined / cancelled. Soft low falling third - a no, not a slap.
Milestone: published. One short bright ding.
Milestone: signed off. Happy da-DING.
Milestone: phase advancing. Joyful da-DING-a-LING, rising.
Milestone: space complete. A single ding that droops a minor third - wistful closure.
Hero cue for the rare big win. Launch, burst, crackle, pentatonic embers.
